title: V6 foundations scaffolded, awaiting first execution
summary: Research suite, free-tier CI and local Debian harness written and committed to branches. Nothing has been executed yet: no pipeline has ever run on this project and the measured house edge is still unknown.

open_merge_requests.title: CSV-first walk-forward research suite
open_merge_requests.note: Must merge before !5. pyproject.toml in !5 collects test_research_*.py, which only exists here.

backend/research/: loader.py: export parsing, ID dedupe, timestamp sort, invariant assertions
labels.py: moonshot-within-horizon target, trailing horizon excluded as None
splitter.py: expanding-window walk-forward folds with assert_causal
strategies.py: BaseRateStrategy and DryStreakStrategy on features.base.BaseFeature
metrics.py: Brier, skill score with paired bootstrap CI, calibration, hit rate, paper EV, drawdown
significance.py: permutation test over round order
runner.py: CLI emitting a JSON artifact
tests: backend/tests/conftest.py: puts backend/ on sys.path, replacing the /home/pirates hardcode
ci: .gitlab-ci.yml: lint + test, research manual, interruptible, one pipeline per change
Makefile: venv lint fmt test cov research audit verify clean
removed: Six legacy print scripts in backend/tests/ — hardcoded /home/pirates path, printed rather than asserted, required a live DB

verified_facts.bands: Ten entries in linguistics.BANDS, lower bound inclusive, cosmic open-ended. 2.0 is 'base', not 'low'
verified_facts.existing_phase_splitter: momento.backtest.split_test_phases provides 10/60/30 warmup/normal/stress; reused via splitter.phase_view with an inline fallback to stay DB-free
verified_facts.feature_contract: features.base.BaseFeature requires compute, backtest, get_metrics, get_name, get_description
verified_facts.filtered_tape: eagle-eye-export-2026-07-28.csv, ~1484 rounds, >=10x only, a strict subset of the full tape

blockers.description: backend/requirements.txt pins torch, tensorrt and cupy-cuda12x. All need CUDA; tensorrt is not installable from PyPI. Any CI job or GPU-less VM installing it fails at setup. Most likely reason no pipeline ever ran on this project.
blockers.resolution: !5 splits requirements-dev.txt (pytest + ruff) and requirements-audit.txt (numpy/pandas/scipy). backend/research/ is pure stdlib, so the test and research loop needs only pytest.
blockers.remaining: Split backend/requirements-api.txt from backend/requirements-gpu.txt so the API server runs on a no-GPU VM. Verify GPU modules degrade gracefully and add a test asserting it. Tracked in #15.

blockers.description: The house edge c is still assumed at ~0.97 rather than measured. #11, #12 and #14 all depend on it.
blockers.resolution: Run 'make research CSV=clean_data.csv' and 'make audit', commit as research report 001. G1 missingness gates the G3 edge estimate.

blockers.description: Parent epic lives in momento-group1 while the project lives in avfsmomentoserver1, so epic rollup is broken.
blockers.resolution: Issue #19 supersedes it as the V6/V7 hub.

blockers.description: gilabtoke.md in the repo root may contain a GitLab token.
blockers.resolution: Review; if it holds a credential, rotate it and purge from history.

make research CSV=clean_data.csv PERMUTATIONS=200; commit as research/reports/001-baseline-clean-data.json
make audit CSV=clean_data.csv to establish missingness before trusting c
Build #8 contracts, then #9 lexicon, then #16 promotion gate

expected_outcome_of_report_001.note: Recorded in advance so the result cannot be rationalised after the fact. This is pre-registration in spirit.
expected_outcome_of_report_001.interpretation: All of the above constitute a PASS. A null is the correct result for a provably fair game and must not be tuned away.
